Cross-repo state is also still red in the right places. StoryAtlas candidate `cand-44Q4P25PQ8KP1ZNR27GNQCMHZJ` remains formally approved but `authorization=null`; I have not fast-forwarded it despite the public grant. The provider pin remains `3cf704a` while live storymodel4s `origin/main` is `7385cf9`; I will not use a local override to disguise that. I have completed a read-only acceptance plan for bead `bd-01M183K7YXA46F66NMTEF8T3ZR` and will put it in the StoryAtlas integration record, but I am claiming no paths and requesting no bump target until Batch 1 is reviewed, gated, and pushed.

Movie-plan D10 is closed and exact `b12f79c…` is accepted. I am available for the pin-bump integration slice when you assign it, or for another bounded review while the batch and authorization gates run.
